purpose: Independent, human-checkable rule and tactical fixture proposals; not a production test-file schema or engine-certified solutions.
coordinate_convention: [row, col], zero-based; row increases down, col increases right; all omitted cells empty

scope.pass_defenses: Covered analytically when the RIF section 5 pass is supported; no forced draw by two passes occurs because attacker always plays.
scope.verification: Hand arguments in rules-research.md; not externally engine-certified. A small independent in-memory geometry exercise checked principal rule labels but was not treated as a rules oracle.
scope.negative_scope: Negative cases refute the nominated root or continuation only; they do not assert that no other winning move exists in the entire position.

Filling c6 creates contiguous c5..8 with both exact-five endpoints; contiguous-three-only matching misses the root three.
